notes.title: DLC Release Day!
notes.content:
[h2][b] ❄️Today is the release of Garden of Seif: Curse of Gravehollow Peaks ❄️ [/b][/h2]

Today we present Curse of Gravehollow Peaks to Steam! This short side story features Iris and Seth from Garden of Seif: Chronicles of an Assassin. 

[img]https://clan.akamai.steamstatic.com/images/42130534/458855c545515909506e293e5b37f32282ea651e.jpg[/img]

[b]About Curse of Gravehollow Peaks:[/b]
in the cursed mountains of Gravehollow Peaks, two rival assassins must set their differences aside and find a way home... unless something finds them first. A story-rich fantasy with magic, romance, and choices that matter. 

[img]https://clan.akamai.steamstatic.com/images/42130534/f2706860fb434921267e4a0f2dfc07e3daf60862.jpg[/img]

The Curse of Gravehollow Peaks DLC was originally posted to itchio and made for the 2021 Winter VN Jam, a casual game jam where we worked on a game in under two months. Since then, we've added new endings and choices, and have even polished the game with new artwork over the years. This is the first time the game is launching on Steam!
[h3]
[url=https://store.steampowered.com/app/2079430/Garden_of_Seif_Curse_of_Gravehollow_Peaks/?utm_source=steam&utm_medium=coaadevlog&utm_campaign=cursedrelease&utm_content=december2023]Visit the Steam page here.[/url][/h3]

[h2]✨Garden of Seif Merch✨[/h2]

You can still find the Chronicles of an Assassin Official Lore Book and Guide Book on our website. 

[h3][b][url=https://www.foxdriftstudios.com/store/p1/merch.html]Click here to visit our official shop.[/url] [/b][/h3]

[img]https://clan.akamai.steamstatic.com/images/42130534/011ab18cdf7b5598049b66ce84b938440eb8eb1a.jpg[/img]

[h2]🧙Support🧙[/h2]

Our customer support email is here and is what you can use to contact us regarding any bugs or issues:

foxdrift.cs@gmail(dot)com

[h2]Thank you, everyone and Happy Holidays![/h2]

notes.title: Release Day + Merch Shop!
notes.content:
[h2][b]🎃Happy October Release!! 🎃[/b][/h2]

Garden of Seif: Chronicles of an Assassin officially released today! Thank you to everyone who supported us by funding the Kickstarter, buying the game, or even simply sharing the game around. 

We sincerely hope that you enjoy the story, and be sure to leave a review telling us what you think! Reviews help small devs like us tremendously because Steam pushes our visibility once we hit 10 reviews, even more so when we surpass that.

[h2]✨Garden of Seif Merch✨[/h2]

You can find the Official Lore Book and Guide Book for the game on our website. The Lore Book features in-depth lore not found in the game journal. The guidebook is beneficial for those looking for a visual guide to achieving all endings. Use the code [b]4LAUNCH [/b] to purchase these digital books for 20% off. We plan to sell some of the extra merch from the Kickstarter soon, so keep an eye out for another announcement from us. 

[h3][b][url=https://www.foxdriftstudios.com/store/p1/merch.html]Click here to visit our official shop.[/url] [/b][/h3]

[img]https://clan.akamai.steamstatic.com/images/42130534/011ab18cdf7b5598049b66ce84b938440eb8eb1a.jpg[/img]


[h2]✨We had a successful QA✨[/h2]

We spent over a month in QA for Garden of Seif, slaying bugs and other issues that impeded gameplay. Even so, there are a few known bugs we are aware of i.e.: ESC button opens the save menu, skipping can cause sprite overlay and cinematic movies to overlap and change positions, the quit menu UI does not pause, causing accidental clicks on the load/save slots.

[img]https://clan.akamai.steamstatic.com/images/42130534/453ccf19ab484421e7c22cd3e228499fa549c4ba.png[/img]

[h2]🧙Support🧙[/h2]

Our customer support email is here and is what you can use to contact us regarding any bugs or issues:

foxdrift.cs@gmail(dot)com

I will do my best to respond to any issues as quickly as I can!

[h2]Thank you, everyone! Let this be a successful launch day!! [/h2]

notes.title: Game Updates, QA, Kickstarter, Player Name Input ✨
notes.content:
Hi Everyone! We've been making swift progress on Garden of Seif, and from here on out, we'll be having more frequent updates on Steam to align with the Kickstarter updates. Here's a quick run down on what's been going on with the project:

[h2][b]    We are in the first phase of QA for the full game. ✨ [/b][/h2]

[img]https://clan.akamai.steamstatic.com/images/42130534/453ccf19ab484421e7c22cd3e228499fa549c4ba.png[/img]

QA is in progress and more details are to be revealed soon. We will know more about a release date once the game passes the QA checklist and no critical issues arise. 

[h2][b]   A player name profanity filter is in-progress. 🛑❗ [/b][/h2]
[img]https://clan.akamai.steamstatic.com/images/42130534/495c9390a5f6ba926081f6495714a5ac3d713793.png[/img]
We're coding a profanity filter for the player assassin name. I didn't plan to add this filter in originally, but after the demo QA (and Chris & and Ashley typing in their hilarious assassin names) we decided it was necessary for the full game. Sorry folks, you won't be able to say bad words, but you will be able to name your assassin Spam and Pineapple Pizza if your heart desires.

[h2]New Character cards incoming!! ✨[/h2]
[img]https://clan.akamai.steamstatic.com/images/42130534/622df17deadb1964fa175c1fca091cd60b56bf3e.png[/img]
    Want to know more about the assassins and the side characters? You can expect new character cards and an official reveal for the main cast coming soon! Follow us on [url=https://twitter.com/FoxdriftStudios]Twitter[/url] and [url=https://www.tumblr.com/foxdriftstudios]Tumblr[/url] for frequent updates.

notes.title: New Demo + General Updates!
notes.content:
Hi Everyone!

It's been awhile since we posted to the Steam page announcements, so if you haven't been following us on our socials, you may be wondering where we are at with development. Ever since the Kickstarter was funded last year, we have steadily made progress to Garden of Seif. This leads to the reason we've decided to update the demo, one last time, so that the demo matches the look and gameplay of the main game, giving players a better inside look of the game before purchasing.

The length and content of the demo remains the same in many ways, there is still a lot that's changed:

[list]
[*] Choose your assassin alias
[*] New & polished UI that's more user friendly
[*] A function gallery
[*] A journal with locked content that will be found in the full game
[*] Iris's hit list, which will update as the player progresses through the main game
[*] Trust or betrayal stat boosting
[*] Grammar/punctual errors
[*] Slight story/lore changes that players won't likely notice
[*] A brand new Start screen by QuantumVelvet
[/list]

[b]Kickstarter backers will be the first to receive the full copy of the game. Right now, we are in the QA testing phase of development for the full game, and if all goes well we will be aiming for a Q3 2023 release! 
[/b]

Please share this game and wishlist it, as it helps us tremendously. :)
